title: Monthly Product Allowance Schedule, Office Pantry & Beverage Program
content:
Each Office Pantry & Beverage Program tier carries a monthly product allowance, a grace share above it, a markup for product taken beyond the allowance, and an interval at which consumption is reviewed with the client.

| Tier | Product value included in the programme fee each month (USD) | Consumption above the allowance absorbed without charge, as a percentage of the allowance | Markup applied to product taken above the monthly allowance (percent) | Months between consumption reviews with the client |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 240.00 | 10.00 | 22.00 | 12 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 780.00 | 8.00 | 20.00 | 6 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 2100.00 | 6.00 | 18.00 | 6 |
| Barista Bar Program | 3400.00 | 5.00 | 16.00 | 3 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 6800.00 | 4.00 | 14.00 | 3 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 14500.00 | 3.00 | 12.00 | 3 |

## The four figures as this schedule states them

1. The allowance is the product value included in the programme fee each month, in United States dollars.
2. The grace share is the consumption above the allowance absorbed without charge, expressed as a percentage of the allowance rather than of the delivered value.
3. The markup is the markup applied to product taken above the monthly allowance, expressed as a percentage.
4. The review interval is the number of months between consumption reviews held with the client.

## Reading the schedule

The allowance rises with the tier while the grace share and the markup fall: Coffee & Tea Service carries the smallest allowance at 240.00 with the widest grace share at 10.00 percent and the highest markup at 22.00 percent, and Campus Pantry Network Program carries the largest allowance at 14500.00 with the narrowest grace share at 3.00 percent and the lowest markup at 12.00 percent. Review intervals shorten in the same direction, from 12 months on the entry tier to 3 months on the three largest tiers.
